landing_preparing: Our new website is being prepared. Member registration will open soon.
sms_otp_code: ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni: your code is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes. Do not share it with anyone.
sms_registration_submitted: ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni: we received your registration. Your reference is {reference}. We will send an SMS when it is approved.
sms_registration_submitted_new_member: ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni: we received your registration, reference {reference}. Please see the Church Secretary to get your FWO number.
sms_registration_correction_requested: ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni: please contact the church office or visit the registration desk about your registration {reference}.
sms_registration_approved: ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni: your registration {reference} is approved. You are now a registered member.
reg_intro: It takes about 3 minutes. Keep your phone with you: we will send you a code.
reg_fwo_hint: The number on your church envelope. Digits only.
reg_new_member_label: I am new / I don't have an FWO number yet
reg_new_member_hint: After you register, please see the Church Secretary, who will give you one.
reg_departments_hint: Choose any you belong to. You can leave this empty.
reg_phone_own: Use a phone number that is yours alone. If you don't have one, the church office will register you and you will vote in person.
reg_phone_why: We send a code to this number to check it is yours, and SMS about your registration. Only church staff who manage the register can see it.
reg_adult_label: I am 18 years old or older.
reg_privacy_label: I have read the privacy notice.
reg_consent_label: I agree to my details being stored on servers outside Kenya, in the European Union.
reg_consent_why: The church's register is kept on servers in the European Union, so the law asks for your agreement. If you don't agree, the church office can register you on paper.
reg_review_hint: Then we will send a code to your phone to check the number is yours.
reg_js_needed: To send you a code, this page needs JavaScript. Please turn it on, or register at the church office or the desk at your AGM.
reg_done_title: Thank you. We have received your registration.
reg_done_sms: We have also sent it to you by SMS.
reg_done_next: The church will review your registration and send you an SMS when it is approved. Keep your reference: you will need it to check your status.
err_too_long: Please use no more than 120 characters.
err_fwo_invalid: Use digits only, as on your envelope.
err_phone_invalid: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, for example 0712 345 678.
err_must_accept: Please tick this box to continue.
err_unavailable: This choice is no longer available. Please choose again.
err_turnstile: We couldn't check that you are not a robot. Please try again.
err_limit_ip: Too many codes have been requested from this network. Please try again in an hour.
err_limit_resend: Please wait a minute before asking for a new code.
err_limit_hourly: You have asked for 3 codes in the last hour. Please try again later.
err_send_failed: We couldn't send the code. Please try again in a few minutes.
err_code_wrong: That code is not right. You have {count} tries left.
err_code_expired: That code has expired. Please get a new code.
err_code_too_many: Too many wrong tries. Please get a new code.
err_verification: Your phone check has expired. Please get a new code.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
